t0.text: Unified interface (roadmap v2 "Just ask"): directions and information architecture

t1.text: 1 · One input box plus suggestions · the same panel on every page (iPhone)

t2.text: 1 · The same panel on iPad · keyboard up

t3.text: 3 · Home is the browser's start page

n1.text: Looks come from the WukongMind design system (ink, gold, jade, cinnabar; one gold ring for the Agent; seals, not capsules; no gradients): https://claude.ai/artifact/5fGhnS4fmcmWYZbPoKTTZ2. Its Composer, SuggestionRow, ToolRow, ResultCard, ScriptCard, Message, Seal, Switch, ListRow and BrowserBar are used throughout; the Logo on onboarding, the Mascot in panel states. Spec: docs/wukongmind/design-unified.md

n2.text: Compare the first two pairs: the title row ("Agent", the ink This page seal "talk.example.org · 2 scripts", ⋯ with model choice) and the input box are the same on a forum thread and an ordinary page. Only the suggestions differ. The status line shows only while a run is going and just after; tool rows use plain labels and fold into "Steps N" when the run ends. Code names, durations and tokens show only in developer mode.

n6.text: Suggestions never grey out: one that does not apply is not shown (a followed thread drops "Notify me…"; a dark page drops "Make it dark"). At most 4 fit; more scroll under a fade. One panel: on the three built-in forums, Summarize, Read it to me, Search this forum… and Notify call today's engines; typed text always goes to the Agent. One loop: every suggestion just sends its text.

n7.text: Gold and the ring mean only the Agent; jade means content from the website (result card headers, citation numbers); cinnabar means stop or error. Site type is internal: the This page seal shows the host and script count only, and the grey forum badge stays only on Home's site tiles.

n3.text: Menus are native Menus only: buttons (title, SF Symbol, optional subtitle), checkmarks, submenus, inline sections, destructive role. Every ⋯ is a Menu; the panel's ⋯ holds model choice. This page has switches, so it is a popover, never a menu. Mic: One panel dictates into the box (the bar's forum voice entry stays); One loop opens the voice session.

n4.text: iPad Settings is the same sheet and NavigationStack as on iPhone, only wider; pages push inside it. Dashed rows (M3, M4, Learn on ask) mark reserved places and are not built until their milestone.

n5.text: Onboarding 3: the "You're set" card appears after a run or Skip; it is drawn together with the prompts here. Step 3 runs in the real browser after the cover/sheet closes.

n8.text: Keyboard up: the status line folds into the header beside "Agent" (spinner + step) and comes back when the keyboard goes. The suggestion row stays while the box is empty and hides as soon as you type.

n9.text: This board draws One loop. The summary, search and podcast are Agent tool calls. In One panel the same taps run today's engines, and their result text is attached as context to the Agent's next message, so the typed "point 2" follow-up works there too.

t7.text: Panel states: one mascot at most

n10.text: Mascot: wave fills the empty panel (128 pt). While working, one 40 pt pose sits inside the status line, before the text, and hides with it: think while waiting on the model, run while tools run, search while reading or searching; cheer when a run ends. It never floats over the conversation. One per screen.

t8.text: M3 · The Agent asks first, and shows its screenshots

t9.text: One loop · Saved answers and voice turns

n11.text: Confirmation card (design-m3 Confirmations): the ScriptCard shell (surface, hairline edge, radius-lg) under the waiting tool row, the question in plain ink text, the full URL (for cookies, the domain) in code style, then Allow (primary) and Don't allow (secondary), 44 pt. The run is paused; the status line keeps "Working · step N" and Stop also cancels the card. Don't allow returns an error to the Agent, which explains in the conversation.

n12.text: Screenshot thumbnail: the image at radius-md with a hairline edge inside the expanded tool row; a tap opens it full size in a sheet. On a page-feedback warning the expanded row shows the before and after screenshots side by side, and the Agent goes on to check the page.

n13.text: Saved answer replaces AgentView for stored Research answers (design-one-loop "After approval"): the forum seal and date, the question, the answer as Markdown with citation chips, then the numbered sources list (DCSourcesList). No input box. Drawn as a page pushed from History; where it opens (History, or the panel as openAgentRun does today) is for the owner to confirm. Home's Recent opens the same view.

n14.text: Voice turns (design-one-loop "Voice", provisional until the spike): what you said is the user bubble and the voice model's reply is Agent text, each led by the waveform glyph in ink-muted. A hand-off runs the Agent like a typed request (Steps, result card). The session's controls stay in the Dock (design-unified).
